modmenu.summaryTranslation.project-water: A flooded overworld: endless ocean at Y=112 with vanilla surface biomes above the waves.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.project-w: Project Waterworld turns the overworld into a flooded world with flat water at Y=112, a natural seabed below, and vanilla biome distribution in the air column for building. Ocean-adapted mobs and structures include wild guardian spawns, drowned riders, and pillager patrols and wandering traders in bamboo rafts. This mod is server-side only—clients do not need it installed to join.
